permission: Gary gave permission to add these portraits to Dune Zone on Discord on 7 November 2026 ("ye you can throw them on there, more stuff for the community the better"). Norbert relayed it and asked for them to be added.
originals: Gary's portraits are his own AI-generated characters.
generation: Built-in imagegen style transfer of Gary's transparent originals, with three original GF9 leader portraits as style references, asking for the loose pen lines and colour washes of the GF9 leaders.
processing: The transparent redraw is composited onto the GF9 leader tan without cropping, then resized with Pillow Lanczos to a lossless RGB PNG.
